list: Official PS5 trophy list as published by PlayStation, via Exophase and PSNProfiles (both agree on every name, description and grade). 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: finish the story, the 100% checklist and every count-based trophy, and this is the last one to unlock. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours at difficulty 4/10.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it; the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is the first story trophy and introduces Jason and Lucia.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1; it pops when the chapter closes. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is reported to disappear after Chapter 1.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 2; it pops when the chapter closes. Chapter 2 is also when both Jason and Lucia become playable, which opens up most of the open-world trophies.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 3; it pops when the chapter closes. The Cartel Heist mission in this chapter also unlocks its own trophy, Break the Bank.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 4; it pops when the chapter closes. Take the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' while you are here: it opens the bank-vault robberies that Maximum Withdrawal needs.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the only hidden gold. Finish the final mission of the story (sources word it as Chapter 5). It pops at the credits. Keep a manual save before the final mission, as the save habits page explains.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story; the trophy pops at the mission's end. No special requirement beyond finishing it.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3; the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is one of the story's big heist set-pieces, so expect a wanted level on the way out.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners when it appears in the story; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport; the trophy pops at the mission's end. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can is earned later in free roam.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, per both PowerPyx and GTABase. Finish the 100% completion checklist after the story: PowerPyx puts its thresholds at roughly 60% of true completion, so most of the work is already done while earning the other trophies. The checklist's own targets run higher than the trophies' in places (300 stunts vs 250, 30 races vs 20, 70 challenges vs 50, 15 card sets vs 3, 8 vaults vs 5), so expect a cleanup phase after the credits.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & 100% Completion Checklist; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind, so a plane or helicopter tour of the bridges racks the count up fast. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once: races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, stunts and the rest. One attempt at each is enough, no win required. Work through the activity list early so you learn which ones you enjoy before grinding their trophies.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. That is the full set, and the 100% checklist counts the same 42, so this trophy and the checklist line up exactly. Practice each weapon's challenge until the gold threshold clicks; accuracy beats speed on most of them.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 spots, so expect three races per location. Learn each course's line before pushing for the win; a clean run beats a fast crash.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Each race only counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one you like. The 100% checklist wants 30 wins, so keep racing past 20 for A Long Road.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots and take his challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types Master of None wants you to try, so this pairs naturally with that trophy.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Head to an arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to the end. Any game counts, so choose the one you are best at.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy is one of the stranger contacts whose mission strand runs alongside the story; finish his chain to the end and the trophy pops. One source warns that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so start Andy's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it for after the credits.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Finish his whole mission strand; the trophy pops at its last mission. Start his chain as soon as it unlocks, since stranger strands are reported to have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Finish his whole mission strand; the trophy pops at its last mission. Start his chain as soon as it unlocks, since stranger strands are reported to have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The five character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are part of this count. One source warns these strands have windows tied to story progress, so begin each chain as soon as it unlocks and do not leave all eight for after the credits.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Finish his whole mission strand; the trophy pops at its last mission. Start his chain as soon as it unlocks, since stranger strands are reported to have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Finish his whole mission strand; the trophy pops at its last mission. Start his chain as soon as it unlocks, since stranger strands are reported to have windows tied to story progress.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag. Meditate at every spot across Leonida: GTABase counts 18 spots, while the 100% checklist counts 15, so the two may count different things and you should visit every spot you find. The first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it is reported to disappear once that chapter ends. Whether that one spot is required is unconfirmed, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTABase; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand asks you to track down one specific animal, but which animal it is has not been confirmed by any guide yet at launch, so check Bret's missions when they appear and follow his clues in game. Do not guess: the method is still unconfirmed.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a finished set is one full set of cards, and you need three sets. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting past this trophy for A Long Road.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app: point it at landmarks, vehicles and points of interest as you travel and the count climbs. The 100% checklist also wants 100, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Whip It Good's 100 vehicles are scanned the same way.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives scattered through activities and the open world; they accumulate naturally while you play, so this usually pops during the grind for the other count trophies. The 100% checklist wants 70, so keep going for A Long Road.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape the red heat zone on the map. Both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route, and bank vault robberies are a reliable way to reach 4 stars. Stay with your partner until the stars clear.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Stay wanted the whole time: if the stars clear, the chain breaks. North Vice City's jewelry stores sit close together, which makes the run short. If the trophy does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List; GTABase

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. According to GTABase you scan them with WAiNK, with no need to drive them, so scanning traffic near busy roads is efficient. This pairs with You WAiNKer!: scan everything you pass and both counts climb together.
trophies.source: GTABase; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter before you start, then trigger it in a fight with a group of gang members and an assault rifle. Cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count, so pick a gang fight for this one.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. GTABase reports the method: steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away from the airport. Get in, get airborne, and keep flying until the trophy pops.
trophies.source: GTABase; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank and use it. GTABase reports the method: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The Rhino is the tank in question, hence the description. Expect heavy resistance at the base, so plan your escape route before you climb in.
trophies.source: GTABase; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone spotting you. Open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, clear out the safe and leave unseen. Patience beats speed here: wait for the staff's patrol pattern before you move.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. First take the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', then follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars on the way out, and have a fast bike ready for the escape. The 100% checklist wants 8 vaults, so keep robbing for A Long Road.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, break into its cargo hold and get away clean. A fast getaway vehicle parked nearby makes the escape much easier.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. This means clearing the fog across the whole map, every region of the state. Flying over the dark patches is reportedly the quickest method, so a plane tour of the uncovered areas finishes it off.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. GTABase counts 9 gangs, so you need one hit per gang. Track which gangs you have hit so you do not repeat one and miss another.
trophies.source: GTABase; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has confirmed the exact steps at launch — PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known. Visit the Ocean Beach bars and look for the interaction; do not trust any step list until a guide confirms it.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known); EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED. GTABase thinks this involves crashing a car out through a showroom window, in the style of the classic showroom escape, but that is unconfirmed and PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. Try a vehicle showroom with a fast car and a window, but treat the method as a guess until a guide confirms it.
trophies.source: GTABase (unconfirmed); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl. The wording is vague — 'follow-through' suggests completing a game or a good follow-through on your throws — and the exact trigger is not pinned down yet, so play a full game there and see. It is listed, not confirmed, by the guides.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: GTABase reports the method: max out Strength for both characters. Train both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to the maximum and the trophy should pop. It is a single-source report, so keep an eye out for confirmation as more players finish the game.
trophies.source: GTABase (single source); EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: GTABase reports the method: perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Your choices across the game build that profile, and 500 profile-changing actions is the count. Warning from both PowerPyx and GTABase: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so check a Criminal Profile guide before going on a rampage for this count.
trophies.source: GTABase (single source); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED. The description hints at a second-chance event — something that only works the second time you try it — but no guide has confirmed the trigger at launch, and PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. It may pop while you play normally; do not chase an unconfirmed method.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known); EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED. GTABase thinks this refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but that is unconfirmed and PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. Keep exploring odd corners of the map; a weird encounter is the likely trigger, and no guide can pin it down yet.
trophies.source: GTABase (unconfirmed); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED. The description says to bowl targets over with a melee drive-by — striking people with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — but the exact target and place are not confirmed yet, and PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. The bowling alley link in the name is a hint, not a confirmed step.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known); EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies, and according to GTABase one fence pays the most, so find the best rate and use it. The total grows during the 100% robberies, so this climbs while you work on the vault and gang trophies.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List; GTABase

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, car mods and property upgrades all count toward the total. It accumulates naturally over a full playthrough, so check your spending near the end and top it up with a big purchase if you are short.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count toward the 8, so you need eight purchased ones on top of whatever the story gives you. Save up before you start buying.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you want to keep, then register each one in the app. This pairs with Whip It Good: discover a vehicle, then register the ones worth keeping.
trophies.source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase official list
